newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips shed losses as bonds recover.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips shed losses as bonds recover.

text.p: U.S. blue chips shed their losses in afternoon trading on Monday, moving in lock-step with a rebound in Treasuries.
The Dow was up 14 points at 8045, leading the NYSE to lift its curbs on index-arbitrage trade at 1431 EDT/1831 GMT.
The Nasdaq composite was still down, off 15 at 1584, amid a downturn in high technology stocks.
The blue chip recovery came as long-term interest rates stabilized. The 30-year bond was up 2/32 at 6.63 percent.
